title: WPMS/2006/2020 of COMMITTEE OF MANAGEMENT ARYA KANYA PATHSHALA INTER COLLEGE ROORKEE Vs DIRECTOR SECONDARY EDUCATION UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
WPMS No. 2006 of 2020
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Alok Mahra, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. G.S. Negi, Additional C.S.C. for the
State of Uttarakhand.
Heard learned counsel for the parties
through video conferencing.
This writ petition has been filed by
Committee of Management - Arya Kanya
Pathshala Inter College, Roorkee, District
Haridwar through its Manager.
According to the petitioner, the last
election for constituting its Committee of
Management was held on 08.10.2017, which
was approved by Chief Education Officer,
Haridwar vide order dated 13.03.2018.
Thus, according to the petitioner, term of
the existing Committee of Management is
going to expire on 12.03.2021. According to
the petitioner, as per Scheme of
Administration governing the institution,
election process has to be started six
months in advance. Accordingly, petitioner
invited applications from desired persons,
who wanted to become a Member of the
Society and thereafter sent the list of
Members for approval to the Chief
Education Officer, Haridwar on 02.09.2020.
Thereafter, on 12.10.2020, petitioner
appointed an Election Officer and sent his
name for approval to the Chief Education
Officer, Haridwar.
Grievance of the petitioner is that the
Chief Education Officer, Haridwar is sitting
tight over the matter and has not
communicated his decision in the matter.
Learned counsel for the petitioner
confines his prayer and submits that the
Chief Education Officer, Haridwar be

directed to take decision in the matter at the
earliest.
Having regard to the facts and
circumstances of the case, the writ petition
is disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to
make fresh representation to the Chief
Education Officer, Haridwar within one week
from today. If such a representation is
made within stipulated time, Chief
Education Officer will look into the matter
and pass a speaking order, in accordance
with law, within a period of three weeks
from the date of production of certified copy
of this order.
